turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, is this Mrs. Iyer from Chennai? I am Inspector Vikram from the Cyber Cell office.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Yes, this is she. Why are you calling me, sir?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Madam, we have intercepted a courier containing illegal narcotics and your Aadhaar number was found inside the package.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: What? That is impossible, I have never sent any such thing!

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Listen carefully, this is a serious offense and we have an arrest warrant ready. You are now under digital arrest, so you must not hang up or tell anyone about this call.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Digital arrest? I don't understand, please tell me what is happening.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: It means your communication is monitored. If you tell your family, you will be charged with obstructing a government investigation.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: I am very scared, sir. Please tell me how to solve this.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: We can clear your name through a verification process. You need to transfer fifty thousand rupees to our secure government clearance account now.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Fifty thousand? I don't have that much readily available in my savings.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: You must arrange it immediately or the local police will arrive at your door in one hour. Do you want to go to jail at your age?

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: No no, please give me ten minutes to talk to my son.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I told you, no talking to anyone. Send the money to the account I am texting you now or face the consequences.
